purpose: Adaptive shared subscriber budget, separate from individual plan rates. Bounds are controller operating limits, not claimed ISP capacity.
source: Owner reports up to 300 Mbps download. Bounded site HTTP downloads measured approximately 41-80 Mbps and a tunnel-routed upload probe approximately 4.2 Mbps. Start at 70M/5M download/upload, decrease on sustained queue delay and probe upward under healthy demand. Upload 50 Mbps is an exploration ceiling, not a measured capacity.
